shared.leaveBlankToKeepKey: Leave blank to keep your saved key.

marketingIntegrations.title: Marketing Integrations
marketingIntegrations.subtitle: Connect SMS and email providers to send forms, campaigns, and OTP codes.

googleDrive.title: Google Drive Backup
googleDrive.description: Automatically back up signed intake forms, agreements, waivers, and invoices to your own Google Drive.
googleDrive.backupsWillStart: Backups will start on the next signed form or invoice.
googleDrive.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect Google Drive? Future signed forms and invoices will not be backed up until you reconnect.
googleDrive.connectExplanation: Sign in with the Google account that should own the backup folder. We'll create a folder named "{{folder}}" in your My Drive and write signed forms and invoices there. We can only see and modify files we create — your other Drive content stays private.
googleDrive.backfillExplanation: Upload signed forms and invoices that pre-date this integration. Re-runnable; already-backed-up records are skipped.

infobip.title: Infobip SMS Configuration
infobip.description: Configure Infobip to send SMS and OTP verification codes to clients.
infobip.senderHelp: Alphanumeric sender IDs (e.g. "Lumiere") require pre-registration in some countries.
infobip.baseUrlHelp: Found in your Infobip portal under API settings (e.g. xxxxx.api.infobip.com).

steps.signUp: Sign up or log in at portal.infobip.com
steps.createKey: Go to API Keys and create a new key
steps.noteBaseUrl: Note your custom API base URL from the portal
steps.enterSender: Enter sender name (register alphanumeric senders if required)

quo.title: Quo SMS & Call Sync
quo.description: Send SMS campaigns and waivers through Quo, and sync inbound SMS replies and call records (with transcripts and summaries) into each client's history. Note: Quo's API cannot place outbound calls — it logs calls that happen through the Quo app.
quo.savedToastDescription: Your Quo settings have been saved successfully.
quo.saveFirstDescription: Please save your Quo configuration before testing.
quo.saveAndTestFirst: Save and test your Quo configuration before enabling history sync.
quo.historySyncDisabledDescription: Quo will no longer send inbound SMS and call events to this CRM.
quo.historySyncEnabledDescription: Inbound SMS replies and call records will now appear in each client's history.
quo.phoneNumberHelp: Must be a number owned by your Quo workspace, in E.164 format.
quo.userIdPlaceholder: US123abc — leave blank to send as the number owner
quo.primaryLabel: Make Quo the default SMS provider

steps.generateKey: In Quo → Workspace Settings → API, generate an API key
steps.enterKey: Enter the key and one of your Quo phone numbers above
steps.enableSync: Click Enable Call & SMS History Sync to log inbound replies and calls

resend.title: Resend Email Configuration
resend.description: Configure your Resend account to send email campaigns. You'll need an API key and verified domain.
resend.savedToastDescription: Your Resend settings have been saved successfully.
resend.saveFirstDescription: Please save your Resend configuration before testing.

lowSessions.title: Low-sessions renewal nudge
lowSessions.description: Email clients (and text them when an SMS provider is enabled) as soon as an active package drops to only a few treatments left, with a link to renew from the client portal. Saved with the configuration above.

steps.verifyDomain: Verify your domain in the Resend dashboard
steps.createKey: Create an API key in the API Keys section
steps.enterKey: Enter your API key and verified email address above

twilio.title: Twilio SMS Configuration
twilio.description: Configure your Twilio account to send SMS campaigns. You'll need your Account SID, Auth Token, and a Twilio phone number.
twilio.savedToastDescription: Your Twilio settings have been saved successfully.
twilio.saveFirstDescription: Please save your Twilio configuration before testing.
twilio.leaveBlankToKeepCredentials: Leave both blank to keep your saved credentials; re-enter both to rotate.

steps.findCredentials: Find your Account SID and Auth Token in the dashboard
steps.setupNumber: Purchase or set up a phone number in Twilio
steps.enterAndTest: Enter the credentials above and test the connection

acuity.title: Acuity Scheduling
acuity.subtitle: Connect your Acuity account, then choose exactly which clients and appointments to bring into the CRM.
acuity.invalidMappingJsonDescription: Check the client portal Acuity mapping before saving.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: In Acuity, go to Integrations → API to find your User ID and API key. The key is stored securely and can't be read back.
connection.savedNotTested: Credentials saved. Test the connection to confirm they work.

import.title: Import from Acuity
import.description: Browse your Acuity account and tick exactly which clients and appointments to bring into the CRM. Nothing is imported until you click Import.
import.connectFirst: Save your Acuity credentials above to start importing.
import.filterPlaceholder: Filter by name, email or phone
import.confirmDescription: They'll be added to the CRM. Clients already in the CRM are linked, not duplicated, and nobody is notified.

clients.intro: Load your Acuity client list, then tick the clients you want in the CRM. Clients already in the CRM are matched by email, or by phone and name, and are never duplicated.
clients.truncated: Showing the first {{n}} clients. Type a name or phone number and click Search Acuity to find others.

status.samePhone: Same phone as {{name}} in the CRM (not linked automatically)

clients.importHelp: New clients are created in the CRM. A client already in the CRM (same email, or same phone and name) is linked, and only their empty fields are filled in. Nothing is sent to your clients.

skipReasons.missing_contact: No email or phone in Acuity
skipReasons.ambiguous_match: Several CRM clients match. Link it by hand.

appointments.truncated: Showing the first {{n}} appointments. Narrow the date range to see the rest.
appointments.filterPlaceholder: Filter by client, service, email or phone

status.willLink: Matches an appointment already in the CRM. It will be linked, not duplicated.
status.sameDay: This client already has a CRM appointment that day at {{time}}

appointments.notLinked: Not linked to a CRM treatment
appointments.createMissingClients: Create clients that aren't in the CRM yet
appointments.importHelp: Past appointments are imported as completed and upcoming ones as scheduled. Clients are not notified. Importing an appointment again picks up changes made in Acuity; edits made in the CRM are kept.

skipReasons.missing_client_details: No name, email or phone in Acuity
skipReasons.ambiguous_client: Several CRM clients match this person

mapping.title: Treatment & staff mapping
mapping.description: Choose which CRM treatment (and staff member) each Acuity appointment type (and calendar) becomes. Saved right away and used for future imports and webhooks.

automation.title: Automatic sync
automation.description: Keep the CRM up to date through Acuity webhooks.
automation.enableHelp: When on, Acuity webhooks keep imported appointments up to date (reschedules and cancellations), and approved client-portal bookings are sent to Acuity.

modes.off: Don't import them. I'll choose manually
modes.existing_clients: Import only for clients already in the CRM
modes.all: Import all of them (creates new clients)

automation.webhookHelp: In Acuity, open Integrations → Webhooks and paste this URL for the appointment events. Acuity signs webhooks with your API key, so there's no separate secret to set up.
automation.mappingHelp: Map CRM treatment IDs to Acuity appointment type IDs and CRM staff IDs to Acuity calendar IDs for approved client requests.
automation.connectFirst: Connect your Acuity account above before changing these settings.

sync.title: Sync status
sync.description: What has come into the CRM from Acuity so far.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
